ui_readings.text:
Broader Earth foundation · provisional local geography
Earth · Coastward Road

A long channel bridge opens onto woodland lanes, working fields and a small roadside settlement. Coastward Road is a provisional extension; Hearthwater and its people retain their existing places and history. Two western junctions continue into Elderweald-facing woodland, an inhabited clearing, a wetland footbridge and an ancient root-channel passage.

Return to Firstlight: available at any time, free. Reopening or switching characters resumes your saved home checkpoint, retaining accepted work. Crossing makes no allegiance, class or main-story choice.

A LASTING PLACE · SEPARATE ONCE-ONLY EPISODE
A Place Beside the Road

Cross to Vessa for supplied fittings, then choose a sheltered sorting bench or a river observation stand. The existing woodland expedition remains available.

Read the choices, route and fee
ELDERWEALD · A ROAD THAT KEEPS ITS ROOTS
Stormfall and the Living Road

Beyond Coastward’s west coppice, the old root-channel still carries water. Rill needs practical help, with two material allocations and a useful weapon project.

Read the living-road expedition
A DEEPER OPTIONAL TRAIL
Wood, Reed and a Road Home

Vessa offers one supply commission across Coastward’s coppice and shore spurs. Prepare a fallen bough, a small reed bundle and loose shore stone, then pack the job supplies beside the bridge. The paid bundle uses existing crafting materials.

Danger and route: The coppice has one territorial skitter farther south. The northern lip of the spur gives a clear approach to the fallen bough. No fight is required. Stay on the supported road and shore overlook; this outing adds no Earth swimming, boats or harvesting of standing trees.

Exact reward: 25 XP (credited up to the existing 9999 stored cap) · 10 sunmarks · 6 wood · 4 fiber · 2 stone. Any one claimed trail unlocks the one-time workshop fitting; subsequent trails pay only these stated rewards.

ui_readings.label: Story invitation and exact two allocations
ui_readings.text:
ELDERWEALD · OPTIONAL EARTH EXPEDITION
Stormfall and the Living Road

A storm has damaged the woodland route. Recover practical supplies, clear two infestations, and brace the living root-channel before delivering your chosen allocation. Rill asks for field work.

Route: leave Coastward’s west coppice for the clearing camp, cross the wetland footbridge, visit the root-channel and return by the glade toward the fields. Two supported junctions join the same country.

Danger: Channel skitter: 64 health / 9 damage, pursues for a marked bite. Root-bank brute: 136 health / 11 damage, closes to 2.6 m and commits to a 3.1 m long, 2 m wide forward sweep. Step beside its locked lane or Brace (3); both have a 1.35-second tell and 2.3-second recovery. Fixed for every weapon; your free road home stays available.

Fixed story payment: 45 XP · 18 sunmarks · 3 ore. Your chosen material allocation is added to this payment.

Weapon project: one Trailward binding on an owned blade or bow: edge +2 attack, or shelter +1 guard / +10 maximum health. Cost: 3 ore, 8 sunmarks and 6 fibre. Inspect before spending; equipment stays yours.

Recover stormfall

Recover already fallen timber and bind it for transport. The standing refuge stays intact. This pays 8 timber and 4 fibre; the binding needs two additional fibre from gathering or one patrol.

8 timber · 4 fibre

Two more fibre are needed for the binding: existing gathering or one completed patrol supplies them.

Prepare managed coppice

Prepare a limited managed allocation with more binding fibre. This pays 4 timber and 8 fibre; the binding can be afforded from this allocation once the currency is claimed.

This allocation supplies the six fibre needed for the binding.
